notes: *their* before *office of trust* answers to no suffix here (contrast אֱמוּנָתָם in v. 18) and is added under rule 18's closing sentence.
כַּגָּדוֹל כַּקָּטָן writes a particle for each member, so each כְּ takes only the English written for it and rule 14's correlative-pair clause does not apply.

The supplied *to*s before *the great* and *the small* are placed on the substantival adjectives under rule 33; reading them as the distributed לְ of לַאֲחֵיהֶם under rule 25 is the competing analysis, and the כְּs cannot hold them, each already having a word of its own (rule 52).
